newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson says opens plant after fire.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson says opens plant after fire.

text.p: Swedish telecommunications group AB LM Ericsson said on Thursday that it opened its domestic plant at Telefonplan in Stockholm again after a fire on Thursday morning caused the company to close off the entire area.
"Most of our employees have access to the area again," Ericsson spokesman Lars Stalberg told Reuters.
A total of 2,500 people work in the area, where Ericsson's headquarters also are located, Stalberg said.
The fire started in one of the work shops that make cases for AXE public telecommunications switches.
"We do not have any theory about how the fire started," Stalberg said.
"We are doing some first estimates about costs for the damages, but it will take a few days," he said, adding that the company is insured.
